title: The 7 stats
summary: Strength, agility, vitality, defense, perception, intelligence and spirit: what each point of each stat gives.

blocks.text: Every awakened has 7 stats , 5 points each at the start, up to 999. You gain points when you level up (3 per level up to level 30, 2 up to 60, 1 up to 100) and from rank-ups. A stat reset gives all your points back.

blocks.text: Each class lists its focus stats on its page, for example Assassin (Strength, Agility, Perception) or Tank (Vitality, Defense, Spirit). Physical skills scale with Strength , magic skills with Intelligence .
